weekend_note: Dry and warm through Friday (low 80s, no rain expected), then showers return for Halloween weekend: about 40 percent Saturday and 50 percent Sunday per FOX10, with a wetter day possible Wednesday. Picks: Blue Angels practice today, Taste of the Beach starting Thursday, the Palafox Halloween Market and Boo at the Zoo on Saturday, and Foo Foo Festival all week. The Ice Flyers games Friday and Sunday are indoors if showers hit. Isaias recovery continues and some smaller events may change, so double-check before heading out.

weekly.title: Palafox Market
weekly.note: Weekly Saturday market. No confirmation found for Oct 24; a Halloween edition is listed for Oct 31 (see events), so check before heading downtown.

weekly.title: Sunday Market on Palafox

events.title: Milton pumpkin patches and farms
events.place: Sweet Season Farms and Holland Farms, Milton
events.note: Sweet Season Farms (2260 Horn Rd, Milton) reopened after the storm: open Sat 9 AM to 5 PM and Sun 11 AM to 5 PM through Nov 8, though its corn maze was damaged. Holland Farms reopened for pumpkin-patch weekends; check its page for hours.

news.title: Major disaster declaration signed for Florida after Isaias
news.summary: Federal aid is now available to Northwest Florida; which of the eight requested counties, Escambia included, qualify for individual assistance is not yet decided.

news.title: Neighbors complain about debris drop-off lot in Escambia County
news.summary: Residents on Mahogany Hill Road cite noise, dust and truck traffic; the state found the lot within standards and no end date is set.

news.title: A&E Fabrics and Crafts to close after storm damage
news.summary: The 1954 store on New Warrington Road is closing for good after its roof was badly damaged, with a clearance sale.

news.title: Navy names three sailors killed in Pensacola crash
news.summary: The wreck happened early Saturday at M Street and Cervantes; police are investigating with NCIS.

news.title: City of Pensacola Isaias recovery update
news.summary: As of Oct 19, 14 parks had reopened, debris pickup was expected to take several passes, and the October neighborhood cleanup moved to Nov 21.

news.title: Pensacola Beach and Perdido Key access after Isaias
news.summary: Public beaches are open, though some Pensacola Beach access points are closed and Fort Pickens has temporary closures; Perdido Key was largely unaffected.

news.title: TSA PreCheck enrollment at Pensacola airport Nov 3 to 6
news.summary: Daily enrollment 9 AM to noon and 1 to 5 PM; the fee is $76.75 for five years.

coverage_note: Written Wednesday, Oct 28. Temperatures come from Weather Underground's 10-day page; rain chances for Oct 31 and Nov 1 come from FOX10 (a Mobile-area outlook), and the rain percentages for Nov 2 to 4 are my rough estimates from forecast precipitation amounts. Search results were thin: Must Do Pensacola, Local Pulse and NorthEscambia.com pages could not be opened, so Gonzalez, Molino, Beulah and Cantonment items are carried over from earlier checks and not reconfirmed, and no new restaurant openings were confirmed. New events came from Visit Pensacola's Halloween list, the Saenger listing and the Blue Wahoos. Ice Flyers dates are carried over. Several events show 'See event page' because times were not confirmed.
